meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动管理 Benchling 平台上的实验室数据录入与查询
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的实验室用 Benchling 管理研发数据,想自动同步和查询。
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data entry and queries on Benchling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your lab uses Benchling and needs automated data entry and lookup.

howto.what: 它会用 Benchling 的 Python SDK 或 v2 REST API 读写你的实验室数据:建 DNA、RNA、蛋白等注册实体,管库存容器与转移,建 ELN 条目和工作流任务,并查询数据仓库。
howto.when: 当你提到 benchling-sdk、v2 API 等,或要求把实验室数据自动化时接管;需先备好 Benchling 租户 URL,以及 API key 或 OAuth 凭据。

say.text: 把这个容器转移到 Freezer Box A1。
say.note: 调用 containers.transfer 完成移动。

say.text: 列出我租户里的所有 DNA 序列,并给出估算总数。

howto.what_en: It uses the Benchling Python SDK or v2 API to work with your lab data: creating DNA/RNA/protein registry entities, managing inventory containers and transfers, building ELN entries and workflow tasks, and querying the Data Warehouse.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention benchling-sdk, the v2 API, etc., or ask to automate lab data; requires a Benchling tenant URL plus an API key or OAuth credentials.

say_en.text: Create a plasmid DNA sequence with benchling-sdk and register it in a given registry.
say_en.note: It verifies credentials first, then creates the entity.

say_en.text: Transfer this container to Freezer Box A1.
List all DNA sequences in my tenant and give the estimated count.
